segments.text: Guys, I hate to be messy, but I just found this app that you can see who he follows without him ever knowing.
This app is called Toxic, and you can track anybody you want as long as you follow them or their account is public.
You can also view stories anonymously.
Girl to girl, you are welcome. I hope you find what you're looking for or not looking for.
Stay toxic out there, my friend.
